title: 间接成本率审查工作底稿
instruction:
你是州交通部审计办公室的合规官，接管 Tomas Achterberg 一直为 Fallowbrook Freight 进行的间接成本率审查。提交的文件涵盖两个报告期的校准合同工作，Naledi Goodwin 和 Ingrid Ibarra 将在下一个周期在没有 Tomas 的情况下审查时依赖你的文件。使用 `Fallowbrook_Freight_rate_submission.xlsx` 连同 `Inglewood_Industries_rate_basis.docx` 为法律顾问准备调查案卷。工作簿包含提交的进度表和支持细节；文档包含提供的费率基础语言和时期背景。在工作目录的顶层交付 `Fallowbrook_Freight_indirect_rate_review.xlsx`，使用该确切文件名。文件应显示提交的费率是否可以接受，如果不可以，确定引入错误的精确进度表行或分配步骤，并显示重新计算的费率。保留对决策重要的源事实，使两个时期之间的比较易于理解，并包括一个简明的方法或审查笔记区域，描述你如何处理重叠行、行特定笔记以及任何不可用的信息。不要静默填充缺失字段或将无支持的说明转化为发现；区分假设、排除项和结论。包括足够的行级支持，以便另一位审查员可以将接受的金额、分配基础、间接成本池和最终费率追溯回提供的材料。在交付的工作簿中保持源材料不变，或提供清晰可追溯的源副本，使工作底稿对法律部门可用而非原始数据倾倒，并使最终接受或例外状态突出。完成的工作簿必须能在没有公式错误的情况下打开，并且必须直接写入工作目录，而不是嵌套文件夹。

---

上述提到的文件位于 `references/`：

- `references/Fallowbrook_Freight_rate_submission.xlsx` — 提交的间接成本进度表、支持分配细节、时期值、行键和用于费率审查的自由文本行笔记。
- `references/Inglewood_Industries_rate_basis.docx` — 用于解释提交文件和追踪计算序列的提供的费率基础语言和时期背景。

将完成的成果写入**当前工作目录的顶层**，使用以下确切文件名：

- `Fallowbrook_Freight_indirect_rate_review.xlsx` — 一份调查案卷，记录审查、源可追溯性、时期比较、行级处理、重新计算的费率以及接受或例外结论。（在工作目录的顶层使用指定的确切文件名写入文件。；不依赖互联网来源或无支持的外部事实。；保持源派生的事实、计算、假设、排除项和结论可区分。；工作簿必须在没有 #REF!、#DIV/0! 或 #VALUE! 错误的情况下打开。）

除了这些文件名之外，不收集任何其他内容。在其他地方或以其他名称编写的正确文件得零分。

materials.text:
INGLEWOOD INDUSTRIES
Rate Basis Memorandum - Calibration Contract Schedules
To: Agnes Lockhart, Director of Financial Controls
From: Inglewood Industries Cost Methods
Date: 8 January 2026
Subject: Period treatment for Fallowbrook Freight rate-detail export
Period and record context
The Fallowbrook Freight calibration-contract rate detail is maintained for FY 2024 and FY 2025. For this export, a logical schedule record is identified by the composite source record key: reporting period | allocation step | schedule line. The same key can appear in an export more than once when an allocation record has been carried forward; it remains one logical record for rate support.
Rate basis
The indirect-cost rate is stated as a percentage and is calculated as the eligible indirect-cost pool divided by the allocation base. The allocation base consists of direct calibration labor and field support labor. Facility support is an indirect pool component. Corporate Administration allocation is also an indirect pool component; executive compensation may appear within that allocation and remains separately identifiable for review.
Allocation sequence
A bonus accrual is introduced in the Fringe Pool step before the rate is calculated. A payroll cross-reference can display that amount in the Allocation Base field on a rate-detail export, but that display does not make it a denominator component. The schedule note for the affected record controls its rate treatment. This memorandum describes the schedule basis only and does not make an allowability determination.
Cost Methods file note: the rate-detail export is a working support schedule; report headers and values should be retained when the schedule is reviewed.

sheets.name: Case Summary
rows: Fallowbrook Freight - Indirect Cost Rate Review
Calibration-contract work | Investigation case file for Legal counsel | Reviewer continuity: Naledi Goodwin and Ingrid Ibarra
EXCEPTION REQUIRED - Submitted rates cannot be accepted as reported.

Exact affected steps: duplicate Corporate Administration allocation record (Executive compensation component) was counted twice; Bonus accrual was shown in Allocation Base despite its note requiring Fringe Pool treatment. The reviewed calculation retains one key occurrence and applies the row-specific exception.
Rate Detail Export rows 9-20; submitted fields
Rate Detail Export rows 9-20; submitted fields
Rate Detail Export; operative table C8:J20; source record key, periods, submitted pool/base fields, Notes.
Source copy retained in this workbook.
Composite key; pool, allocation base and rate convention; bonus and executive-compensation context.
Method, Assumptions, Exclusions, and Conclusion Basis

Method: Group records by the memorandum-defined composite source record key (reporting period | allocation step | schedule line). Retain the first occurrence in source order and list subsequent same-key occurrences as excluded overlaps.

Row-specific note override: When Notes states an exception, the note controls the reviewed amount. For Bonus accrual, move the displayed Allocation Base amount to Fringe Pool and set reviewed Allocation Base to $0. Do not count it in both pool and base.

Allocation sequence: reviewed pool includes Facility support, Corporate Administration allocation (with the executive compensation component shown separately), and note-adjusted Fringe Pool. Reviewed base includes Direct calibration labor and Field support labor only.

Information not available: no independent payroll, general ledger, or allowability support was supplied. These matters are unresolved; no factual value was assumed or added. This is a rate-basis and arithmetic review only.

Conclusion: Require an exception to the submitted FY 2024 and FY 2025 rates. The observed movement is supported by displayed pool and base changes, including the higher retained Facility support, executive-compensation allocation, bonus accrual, and base amounts in FY 2025; no business cause is asserted.

criteria.description: 交付的工作簿包含一个清晰可辨的审查结论，说明提交的费率是被接受还是需要例外。
criteria.evidence: 渲染的工作簿和提取的单元格文本
criteria.grader_hint: 确认审查员可以找到明确的接受或例外状态，而无需从无标签的数字中推断。

original.criterion: The delivered workbook contains a clearly identifiable review conclusion stating whether the submitted rate is accepted or requires an exception.
original.evidence: Rendered workbook and extracted cell text
original.grader_hint: Confirm that a reviewer can find an explicit acceptance or exception status without inferring it from unlabeled numbers.

criteria.description: 工作底稿确定了 Fallowbrook Freight 和间接成本率审查主题。
criteria.grader_hint: 搜索可见标题、元数据和结论区域。

original.criterion: The workpaper identifies Fallowbrook Freight and the indirect-cost-rate review subject.
original.grader_hint: Search visible titles, metadata, and conclusion areas.

criteria.description: 工作底稿列出了两个提供的源文件，或以其他方式提供了等效的可追溯源引用。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查两个文件名是否在提交的工作簿中可识别。

original.criterion: The workpaper names both supplied source files or otherwise provides an equivalent traceable source citation.
original.grader_hint: Check that both filenames are identifiable in the submitted workbook.

criteria.description: 工作底稿保留了源使用的报告期区分，并没有将时期合并为一个不可追溯的单一总计。
criteria.grader_hint: 将每个报告的费率或总计追溯到提供的时期之一。

original.criterion: The workpaper preserves the reporting-period distinction used by the sources and does not merge the periods into an untraceable single total.
original.grader_hint: Trace every reported rate or total to one of the supplied periods.

criteria.description: 来自提供提交的每一个重要进度表行都被表示出来，要么在审查的计算中，要么在明确的排除或例外列表中。
criteria.grader_hint: 将源进度表键和标签与工作底稿进行比较；遗漏需要有明确记录的处理方式。

original.criterion: Every material schedule line from the supplied submission is represented, either in the reviewed calculation or in an explicit exclusion or exception listing.
original.grader_hint: Compare source schedule keys and labels with the workpaper; omissions need an explicit documented treatment.

criteria.description: 工作底稿确定了提供的源中陈述的进度表键，并一致地使用该键以实现可追溯性。
criteria.evidence: 源键字段和工作底稿行
criteria.grader_hint: 验证行引用或复制的键是稳定的，并且不仅仅被行位置所替代。

original.criterion: The workpaper identifies the schedule key stated in the supplied sources and uses that key consistently for traceability.
original.evidence: Source key field and workpaper rows
original.grader_hint: Verify that row references or copied keys are stable and not replaced only by row positions.

criteria.description: 共享源定义键的行在重新计算的进度表中不被多次计数。
criteria.evidence: 去重后的细节和汇总总计
criteria.grader_hint: 按源中陈述的键对提交记录进行分组，并比较工作底稿包含的总体。

original.criterion: Rows sharing the source-defined key are not counted more than once in the recomputed schedule.
original.grader_hint: Group the submitted records by the key stated in the sources and compare the workpaper's included population.

criteria.description: 对重复或重叠记录的处理方式是可辩护且有记录的，而不是静默丢弃一条记录。
criteria.grader_hint: 令人满意的解释会确定重叠，陈述保留或合并它的基础，并允许另一位审查员重现该选择。

original.criterion: The treatment of the duplicate or overlapping records is defensible and documented rather than silently dropping one record.
original.grader_hint: A satisfactory explanation identifies the overlap, states the basis for retaining or consolidating it, and permits another reviewer to reproduce the choice.

criteria.description: 源笔记列中的行特定例外在笔记表明如此的地方覆盖冲突的主列值。
criteria.evidence: 复制的笔记、处置和计算
criteria.grader_hint: 对于每个标记为例外的源笔记，将应用的值或状态与例外措辞进行比较。

original.criterion: Row-specific exceptions in the source notes column override conflicting main-column values wherever the notes indicate that they do.
original.grader_hint: For each source note marked as an exception, compare the applied value or status with the exception wording.

criteria.description: 工作底稿在受影响行旁边保留了相关的源笔记文本或忠实的释义。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查例外是否可以在不重新打开源工作簿的情况下被理解。

original.criterion: The workpaper retains the relevant source note text or a faithful paraphrase beside the affected row.
original.grader_hint: Check that the exception can be understood without reopening the source workbook.

criteria.description: 重新计算的直接或包含成本基数等于经过重复和笔记处理后的源支持组件。
criteria.grader_hint: 从保留的源行重新计算并与工作底稿基数进行比较。

original.criterion: The recomputed direct or included-cost base equals the source-supported components after duplicate and note treatment.
original.grader_hint: Recalculate from the retained source rows and compare to the workpaper base.

criteria.description: 重新计算的间接成本池等于经过分配金额的有记录处理后的支持池组件。
criteria.grader_hint: 根据提供的进度表和基础文档验证包含、排除和分配处理方式。

original.criterion: The recomputed indirect-cost pool equals the supported pool components after the documented treatment of allocated amounts.
original.grader_hint: Verify inclusion, exclusion, and allocation treatment against the supplied schedules and basis document.

criteria.description: 工作底稿将用于费率的分配基础追溯到源支持的基础，而不是替换为未解释的分母。
criteria.grader_hint: 从保留的进度表行重新执行分母计算，并将其与显示的分母进行比较。

original.criterion: The workpaper traces the allocation base used for the rate to the source-supported base rather than substituting an unexplained denominator.
original.grader_hint: Reperform the denominator from the retained schedule rows and compare it with the denominator shown.

criteria.description: 最终重新计算的费率是审查后的间接成本池除以审查后的分配基础，以与提交相同的费率惯例表示。
criteria.grader_hint: 重新执行除法并检查百分比或小数表示是否一致标注。

original.criterion: The final recomputed rate is the reviewed indirect-cost pool divided by the reviewed allocation base, expressed in the same rate convention as the submission.
original.grader_hint: Reperform the division and check whether percentage or decimal presentation is labeled consistently.

criteria.description: 每个提供报告期的重新计算费率与源派生结果在 ±0.1 个百分点内一致。
criteria.grader_hint: 从保留的源行推导每个预期费率，并与工作底稿进行数值比较。

original.criterion: The recomputed rate for each supplied reporting period agrees with the source-derived result within ±0.1 percentage points.
original.grader_hint: Derive each expected rate from the retained source rows and compare numerically with the workpaper.

criteria.description: 如果工作底稿提供了重新计算的汇总费率，则该费率与源自数据的汇总费率在±0.1个百分点以内一致。
criteria.grader_hint: 仅当提供了汇总数据时才进行评分；核实其是否按适用的基数加权，而非简单平均值。

original.criterion: The recomputed aggregate rate, if the workpaper presents one, agrees with the source-derived aggregate within ±0.1 percentage points.
original.grader_hint: Score only if an aggregate is presented; verify it is weighted by the applicable base rather than a simple average.

criteria.description: 工作底稿指出了导致重大差异的具体计划表行项目或分配步骤，而不仅仅是将最终费率描述为偏高或偏低。
criteria.grader_hint: 所引用的行项目或步骤必须映射到特定的源键、标签或分配阶段，并解释其如何改变费率。

original.criterion: The workpaper identifies the exact schedule line or allocation step responsible for the material discrepancy, rather than merely describing the final rate as high or low.
original.grader_hint: The cited line or step must map to a specific source key, label, or allocation stage and explain how it changes the rate.

criteria.description: 已识别错误对重新计算的资金池、基数或费率的影响，在数值上与辅助计算保持一致。
criteria.evidence: 错误桥接或调整计划表
criteria.grader_hint: 重新计算提交处理与复核处理之间的差异，并确认其方向和幅度。

original.criterion: The identified error's effect on the recomputed pool, base, or rate is numerically consistent with the supporting calculation.
original.grader_hint: Recalculate the difference between submitted and reviewed treatment and confirm the direction and magnitude.

criteria.description: 对于每个复核期间，工作底稿区分了提交费率和重新计算费率。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查标签是否清晰标明哪些数字是报告提交值，哪些是复核人员计算值。

original.criterion: The workpaper distinguishes the submitted rate from the recomputed rate for every period reviewed.
original.grader_hint: Check that labels make clear which figures are reported submissions and which are reviewer calculations.

criteria.description: 提交费率的环比变化已显示，或者可以直接从显示的值中重新计算得出。
criteria.grader_hint: 使用显示的期间费率验证变化。

original.criterion: The period-over-period change in the submitted rate is shown or can be directly recomputed from displayed values.
original.grader_hint: Verify the change using the displayed period rates.

criteria.description: 重新计算费率的环比变化已显示，或者可以直接从显示的值中重新计算得出。
criteria.grader_hint: 使用显示的重新计算费率验证变化。

original.criterion: The period-over-period change in the recomputed rate is shown or can be directly recomputed from displayed values.
original.grader_hint: Verify the change using the displayed recomputed rates.

criteria.description: 对重大期间变动的解释有提供的计划表支持，且未断言无依据的业务原因。
criteria.grader_hint: 接受与观察到的成本、基数、分配或处理变化相关的解释；拒绝虚构的运营或合同事实。

original.criterion: The explanation of the material period movement is supported by the supplied schedules and does not assert an unsupported business cause.
original.grader_hint: Accept explanations tied to observed cost, base, allocation, or treatment changes; reject invented operational or contractual facts.

criteria.description: 当来源显示高管薪酬进入分配资金池时，工作底稿单独报告该金额或处理方式。
criteria.grader_hint: 追踪高管薪酬源行项目至工作底稿，并核实其处理方式可见。

original.criterion: The workpaper separately reports the executive-compensation amount or treatment where the sources show it entering an allocated pool.
original.grader_hint: Trace the executive-compensation source line into the workpaper and verify its treatment is visible.

criteria.description: 工作底稿确定了高管薪酬被包含、排除或重分类的分配阶段。
criteria.grader_hint: 要求提供阶段或计划表行项目引用，而不仅仅提及高管薪酬。

original.criterion: The workpaper identifies the allocation stage at which executive compensation is included, excluded, or reclassified.
original.grader_hint: Require a stage or schedule-line reference, not merely a mention of executive compensation.

criteria.description: 奖金应计项的处理与源注释一致，且未在资金池和基数中重复计算。
criteria.grader_hint: 追踪奖金应计项通过资金池和基数计算，并检查是否存在重复计算。

original.criterion: The bonus accrual is treated consistently with the source note and is not counted both in the pool and in the base.
original.grader_hint: Trace the bonus accrual through both pool and base calculations and check for double counting.

criteria.description: 工作底稿以另一位复核人员可以跟随的方式解释了奖金应计项与明显费率误差之间的关系。
criteria.grader_hint: 解释必须连接源行项目、分配步骤和费率后果。

original.criterion: The workpaper explains the relationship between the bonus accrual and the apparent rate error in a way another reviewer can follow.
original.grader_hint: The explanation must connect source row, allocation step, and rate consequence.

criteria.description: 从复核计算中排除的源行项目已列出，并附有与其键或注释相关的原因。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查所有排除项，并要求每一项都有基于来源的理由。

original.criterion: Source rows excluded from the reviewed calculation are listed with a reason tied to their key or note.
original.grader_hint: Inspect all exclusions and require a source-grounded reason for each.

criteria.description: 没有源行项目在处置中被排除的同时又在重新计算的总计中被包含。
criteria.grader_hint: 通过源键连接行项目，并将处置状态与计算成员资格进行比较。

original.criterion: No source row is both excluded in the disposition and included in the recomputed totals.
original.grader_hint: Join rows by the source key and compare disposition status with calculation membership.

criteria.description: 任何缺失的源字段都已明确标识，且工作底稿说明其是保持未解决、假设还是排除。
criteria.grader_hint: 不要求特定的缺失数据惯例；要求一致性和可见性。

original.criterion: Any absent source field is clearly identified, and the workpaper states whether it was left unresolved, assumed, or excluded.
original.grader_hint: Do not require a particular missing-data convention; require consistency and visibility.

criteria.description: 缺失字段未被填充为作为源数据呈现的虚构事实值。

spec.professional_context: The State DOT Office of Audit is preparing an indirect-cost-rate acceptance decision for calibration-contract work submitted by Fallowbrook Freight. Tomas Achterberg is the departing reviewer, and Naledi Goodwin and Ingrid Ibarra need a workpaper that another reviewer or Legal counsel can follow next cycle.
difficulty_sources: The supplied rate schedule uses a banner block and gutter columns, so the operative table is not located at A1.
A free-text notes column contains row-specific exceptions that override values in the main schedule columns.
The sources contain duplicate or overlapping schedule rows that must be de-duplicated using the key stated in the source material.
The submission total is plausible, while the material error is introduced within the allocation sequence rather than by an obviously incorrect final formula.
Two reporting periods must be compared and material movements explained without inventing unsupported causes.

semantic_content: A two-period indirect-cost-rate submission for Fallowbrook Freight calibration-contract work.
Submitted schedule lines for direct cost, indirect-cost pools, allocation bases, executive compensation, bonus accrual, and final rates.
Supporting row-level records with a source-defined composite key that identifies the schedule record uniquely.
A free-text Notes field containing several row-specific exceptions that explicitly override one or more main-column values.
A plausible submitted total and rate for each period, with the material error introduced in the allocation sequence rather than through an obviously impossible total.
required_layout_defects: Include a banner block above and to the left of the operative table, with gutter columns, so the real table does not begin at A1.
Include the source-defined key in the operative table.
Include the free-text notes column carrying per-row exceptions that override the main columns.
Include duplicate or overlapping rows sharing the source-defined key.

semantic_content: A supplied rate-basis memorandum used as the governing source for the review, written as an ordinary internal document rather than a purpose-built answer key.
The applicable period labels and definitions of pool, allocation base, and rate.
The source-defined key used to identify schedule records.
Context showing how executive compensation may appear inside an allocated pool and how a bonus accrual can appear again in the base.
Enough source language to let a competent reviewer identify the intended calculation sequence without stating the answer to the case.
Inglewood_Industries_rate_basis.docx.layout: Keep the document text-extractable and coherent; do not add a separate rulebook or explicit solution.

numbers_and_entities.instruction: Use invented internally consistent amounts, dates, percentages, row labels, and source keys. Do not reuse literal numbers from the task prompt.

seeded_defects: Exactly one banner-and-gutter placement defect: the operative table is offset from A1 by a visible banner block and gutter columns.
Exactly one notes-column defect: per-row free-text exceptions override conflicting main-column values.
Exactly one duplicate/overlap defect: multiple records share the source-defined key and require de-duplication.
Do not seed unrelated formula errors, malformed dates, inconsistent units, broken links, hidden image-only facts, or additional standard data-quality traps.
transformation: The solver must reshape the two supplied sources into a new investigation workpaper.
The solver must preserve material source facts, identify the reviewed population, document row dispositions, compare the two periods, trace the allocation sequence, and recompute the rate.

The gold is derived from the source relationships: apply the source-defined key for de-duplication, apply each note override to its affected row, follow the supplied rate-basis sequence, reconcile submitted to reviewed values, and identify the schedule step that changes the rate.

gold_derivation.method: Use an offline reference script plus independent manual review to parse the operative table, group duplicate keys, apply note overrides, calculate each period's reviewed pool and base, compute reviewed rates, and generate expected relational checks.
numeric_rules: Each period's reviewed pool is the sum of retained and note-adjusted eligible pool components.
Each period's reviewed base is the sum of retained and note-adjusted eligible base components.
Each reviewed rate equals reviewed pool divided by reviewed base, expressed in the source's rate convention.
The submitted-to-reviewed bridge must equal the sum of the documented duplicate, override, and allocation-step adjustments.
Period movement is calculated from the displayed period rates and supported component movements.
judgment_rules: The source key determines duplicate identity; the workpaper must make the chosen retained or consolidated treatment visible.
A free-text exception controls the affected main-column value when the note clearly does so; ambiguous text must be disclosed rather than silently resolved.
The error finding must point to the exact source schedule line or allocation step whose treatment creates the material difference.

quality_gate: Build an imagined competent solution in an offline spreadsheet.
Confirm every numeric rubric item can be recalculated from the two sources within its stated tolerance.
Confirm every source layout defect is discoverable and addressed.
Confirm the source facts, row dispositions, period comparison, rate calculation, and conclusion are internally consistent.
Open and scan the generated workbook for #REF!, #DIV/0!, and #VALUE! before marking the reference solution as passed.

original_instruction:
You are a compliance officer in the State DOT Office of Audit, taking over the indirect cost rate review that Tomas Achterberg has been carrying for Fallowbrook Freight. The submission covers calibration-contract work for two reporting periods, and Naledi Goodwin and Ingrid Ibarra will rely on your file when the next cycle is reviewed without Tomas. Use `Fallowbrook_Freight_rate_submission.xlsx` together with `Inglewood_Industries_rate_basis.docx` to prepare an investigation case file for Legal counsel. The workbook contains the submitted schedule and supporting detail; the document contains the supplied rate-basis language and period context. Deliver `Fallowbrook_Freight_indirect_rate_review.xlsx` in the top level of the working directory, using exactly that filename. The file should show whether the submitted rate can be accepted and, if not, identify the exact schedule line or allocation step that introduced the error and show the recomputed rate. Preserve the source facts that matter to the decision, make the comparison between the two periods understandable, and include a concise method or review-notes area describing how you treated overlapping rows, row-specific notes, and any information that was not available. Do not silently fill an absent field or turn an unsupported explanation into a finding; distinguish an assumption, an exclusion, and a conclusion. Include enough row-level support that another reviewer can trace the accepted amounts, allocation base, indirect-cost pool, and final rate back to the supplied materials. Keep the source material unchanged within the delivered workbook or provide a clearly traceable source copy, keep the workpaper usable for Legal rather than as a raw dump, and make the final acceptance or exception status prominent. The completed workbook must open without formula errors and must be written directly to the working directory rather than to a nested folder.

---

The files referred to above are in `references/`:

- `references/Fallowbrook_Freight_rate_submission.xlsx` — Submitted indirect-cost schedules, supporting allocation detail, period values, row keys, and free-text row notes for the rate review.
- `references/Inglewood_Industries_rate_basis.docx` — Supplied rate-basis language and period context used to interpret the submission and trace the calculation sequence.

Write your finished work to the **top level of the current working directory**, using exactly these filenames:

- `Fallowbrook_Freight_indirect_rate_review.xlsx` — An investigation case file documenting the review, source traceability, period comparison, row-level treatment, recomputed rate, and acceptance or exception conclusion. (Write the file at the top level of the working directory using exactly the specified filename.; Do not rely on internet sources or unsupported external facts.; Keep source-derived facts, calculations, assumptions, exclusions, and conclusions distinguishable.; The workbook must open without #REF!, #DIV/0!, or #VALUE! errors.)

Nothing outside those filenames is collected. A correct file written anywhere else, or under any other name, scores zero.
